experiment.description: Large-network authority gravity test. 100 nodes, 100 claims, small-world topology, full primitive set, static trust, claim cycling enabled. Tests whether authority gravity compounds continuously at 100-node scale or saturates as in the 7-node batch. Primary metric: Gini delta from scale-matched null baseline. Secondary: ESI stability, resolution rate.

hypotheses.description: Authority gravity emerges at 100-node scale: Gini rises from null baseline
hypotheses.note: Predicted to rise as in 7-node batch. If flat, the mechanism does not generalise to this network size — a significant negative finding.

hypotheses.description: Authority gravity exceeds 7-node equilibrium: Gini delta (active minus null) is greater than 0.175 at equilibrium — the saturation ceiling from the prior batch. Tests whether larger interaction surface unlocks compounding.
hypotheses.note: This is the hypothesis that distinguishes topology-bounded saturation from topology-independent compounding. If delta > 0.175: compounding is topology-sensitive and unlocks at scale. If delta ≈ 0.175: saturation is intrinsic to the mechanism regardless of network size.

hypotheses.description: Authority gravity does not reach equilibrium by tick 5000: Gini is still rising in the final 1000 ticks. Tests whether compounding is unbounded at this scale or saturates at a higher ceiling.
hypotheses.note: If Gini is flat in this window, gravity saturates (higher ceiling than 7-node but still bounded). If still rising, gravity may be unbounded at 100-node scale — consistent with the vault's original claim.

hypotheses.description: ESI remains high (≥ 0.8) throughout: full governance is stable at scale
hypotheses.note: If ESI degrades below 0.8 in a high-Gini regime, authority concentration eventually undermines the epistemic stability it initially produced. This would be a new finding not observed in the 7-node batch.

hypotheses.description: Claim cycling sustains live system: transitions continue past tick 1000
hypotheses.note: Diagnostic for the revisability_rate mechanism. If transition count plateaus after tick 1000, the cycling rate is too low and the system has entered a slow-motion absorbing state. Increase revisability_rate and rerun.
